objective: Genuine short-time PDE existence: heat-semigroup mild solution / Banach contraction on the precisely defined space BUCn = bounded uniformly continuous functions on R^n with the sup norm, with all DuhamelSetup bridge obligations discharged for the explicit D10/D11 Gaussian kernel; derivative-loss and quasilinear Ricci-DeTurck barriers identified and partially proved.

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.existsUnique_heatMildSolution
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) {L : ℝ≥0} (F : BUCn n → BUCn n) (hF : LipschitzWith L F) (u₀ : BUCn n) {T : ℝ} (hT : 0 ≤ T) (hK : 1 * L * T < 1), ∃! u : (Icc 0 T) →ᵇ BUCn n, (gaussianSetup n F hF u₀).duhamelMap T hT u = u
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (concrete PDE existence: short-time existence and uniqueness of the mild solution of ∂ₜu = Δu + F(u), u(0) = u₀, on the Banach space BUCn n)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.heatConv_semigroup
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) {t s} (ht : 0 < t) (hs : 0 < s) (f : BCFn n), heatConv n t (heatConv n s f) = heatConv n (t + s) f
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (operator semigroup law K_t K_s = K_{t+s} on BCF(ℝⁿ); Fubini via integrable_prod_iff + D10 gaussianKernel_convolution)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.heatConv_tendsto_self_BUC
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) (f : BUCn n), Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => heatConv n t f.val) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 f.val)
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (strong continuity of the Gaussian heat semigroup at t = 0⁺ on bounded uniformly continuous data; uniform-continuity modulus split + D11 tail estimate)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.gaussianSmap_continuous
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n), Continuous fun p : ℝ × BUCn n => gaussianS n p.1 p.2
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (the exact smap_continuous obligation of DuhamelSetup for the heat semigroup; via abstract jointContinuous_of_absSemigroup)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.jointContinuous_of_absSemigroup
proved_declarations.type: abstract: S 0 = 1, S t = S |t|, semigroup law for t,s ≥ 0, ‖S t‖ ≤ M for t ≥ 0, strong continuity at 0⁺ ⊢ Continuous fun p : ℝ × E => S p.1 p.2
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (abstract strongly-continuous-semigroup joint continuity, any normed space E)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.gaussianS_norm_le / gaussianS_add
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) (t) (ht : 0 ≤ t), ‖gaussianS n t‖ ≤ 1; ∀ (n) (t) (ht : 0 ≤ t) (s) (hs : 0 ≤ s), gaussianS n (t + s) = (gaussianS n t).comp (gaussianS n s)
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (L∞ contraction bound M = 1, attained on constants by heatConv_const; CLM semigroup law)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.heatMildSolution_initial
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) {L} (F) (hF) (u₀) {T} (hT) (hK), (heatMildSolution n F hF u₀ hT hK) ⟨0, ⟨le_rfl, hT⟩⟩ = u₀
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (initial condition u(0) = u₀ via gaussianS n 0 = id)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.heatMildSolution_duhamel_eq_kernel
proved_declarations.type: kernel-form Duhamel identity: u(t) = K_t u₀ + ∫₀ᵗ K_{t-s} F(u(s)) ds on BCF-valued functions (val commutes with the interval integral via valCLM.intervalIntegral_comp_comm; kernel form holds a.e. on (0,t))

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.linearCandidate_isFixedPt / heatMildSolution_linear_eq / linearHeat_example / linearHeat_example_nontrivial
proved_declarations.type: for c ≠ 0, w(t) = e^{ct}·K_t u₀ satisfies the Duhamel equation of ∂ₜu = Δu + c·u, hence equals the unique mild solution; the instance c = 1/2, u₀ = 1, T = 1 has solution const e^{t/2}, verified nonzero and time-dependent
proved_declarations.semantic_class: model (closed-form check of the abstract theorem against the classical explicit solution — non-vacuity)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.existsUnique_arctanHeatMildSolution / arctanF_not_additive
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) (u₀) {T} (hT) (hK : 1·1·T < 1), ∃! mild solution of ∂ₜu = Δu + arctan(u); arctanF fails additivity (arctan 2 ≠ π/2)
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (genuinely nonlinear, globally 1-Lipschitz source — a nonlinear PDE existence theorem with no closed form)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.deturckFlowSymbol_eq_negativeLaplacian / deturckSymbol_quadratic
proved_declarations.type: σ(-2 Ric + L_W g)(ξ) = -|ξ|²_g·Id (from D9 flowSymbol); |cξ|²_g = c²|ξ|²_g
proved_declarations.semantic_class: bridge (strict parabolicity of Ricci-DeTurck at the symbol level; degree-2 ξ-homogeneity = the derivative-loss signature)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.not_lipschitz_of_homogeneous_two / squareF_not_lipschitz / quasilinearRicciDeTurckBarrier_discharged
proved_declarations.type: any nonzero 2-homogeneous map on a normed space is not L-Lipschitz for any L; hence u ↦ u² on BCFn n fails the F_lipschitz field of DuhamelSetup — the quasilinear barrier is discharged (proved), not assumed
proved_declarations.semantic_class: barrier (quasilinear regularity obstruction, proved at the model level and recorded at the symbol level)

proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) {t} (ht : 0 < t) (f : BCFn n), HasFDerivAt (fun x : Vn n => heatConvPoint n t x f) (∫ y, kernelIntegrandFderiv n t f 0 y) 0
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (differentiation under the Bochner integral for the heat convolution at 0, via mathlib hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le with the explicit integrable domination domBound: |∇_x K_t(x-y) f y| ≤ C_t (‖y‖+1) exp(-‖y‖²/(8t)))

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.heatConv_fderiv_zero_apply
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) {t} (ht) (f : BCFn n) (v : Vn n), fderiv ℝ (fun x => (heatConv n t f) x) 0 v = (1/(2t)) · ∫ y, gaussianKernel n t y · ⟪y, v⟪ · f y
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (the exact fderiv formula at 0, the derivative-under-integral bridge named by mildToClassicalBridge)

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.integral_exp_neg_mul_normSq_sq_coord
proved_declarations.semantic_class: general (quadratic Gaussian moment on ℝⁿ via PiLp.volume_preserving_toLp + Fubini integral_fintype_prod_volume_eq_prod + D10 1D moments)

proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) {t m} (ht) (hm) (i), fderiv ℝ (fun x => (heatConv n t (testF n i m hm)) x) 0 (eᵢ) = (4 m t + 1)^(-(n/2+1))

proved_declarations.name: Poincare.D12.ParabolicLocal.derivativeLossBarrier_holds
proved_declarations.type: ∀ (n) (hn : 0 < n), ¬ ∃ C, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ t > 0, ∀ f : BCFn n (Differentiable), ‖fderiv ℝ (fun x => (heatConv n t f) x) 0‖ ≤ C · ‖f‖

expanded_hypotheses: BUCn n = bundled {f : BCFn n // UniformContinuous f} with the BCFn supremum norm: complete Banach space (uniform ε/3 limit argument), ℝ-normed vector space; completeness is why the Banach fixed point applies and strong continuity of K_t at 0⁺ holds (it fails on merely bounded continuous data)

gaussianSetup fields: S = gaussianS n (id at t = 0, |t|-heat convolution otherwise; norm ≤ 1 with M = 1), smap_continuous = gaussianSmap_continuous (proved), smap_norm_le = gaussianS_norm_le (proved), F_lipschitz user-provided
contraction condition 1·L·T < 1 with M = 1: satisfied e.g. by T = 1, L = 1/2 (linear example) and T = 1/2, L = 1 (arctan example)

the Gaussian kernel is the D10 gaussianKernel n t x = (4πt)^{-n/2} exp(-‖x‖²/(4t)); all kernel facts (mass 1, semigroup identity, tail estimate, heat equation) are imported from D10/D11 proofs, no kernel fact is assumed here
the Duhamel map uses the clamped extension of u to ℝ (equal to u on [0,T]); the value at the null endpoint s = t of the interval integral is irrelevant (a.e. kernel form)
semantic_class: genuine short-time existence for semilinear parabolic PDE: abstract Banach contraction + complete spatial space BUCn + fully discharged Gaussian heat-semigroup instance + closed-form and nonlinear examples; quasilinear Ricci-DeTurck barriers proved at the model/symbol level and named as Props beyond that
